name: Correlation/Covariance
description: Computes labeled correlation and covariance matrices with explicit missing-data alignment.

variables_axis.title: Variables axis
variables_axis.description: Axis whose positions are treated as variables; all remaining axes are flattened into aligned observations.

variable_start.title: First variable
variable_start.description: First variable index to include on the selected variables axis.

variable_count.title: Variable count
variable_count.description: 0 selects all variables from variable_start; positive values select a contiguous range.

missing_policy.title: Missing policy
missing_policy.description: listwise drops observations missing in any selected variable; pairwise drops missing observations per pair.

max_variables.title: Maximum variables
max_variables.description: Safety budget for the square output matrix.
